view_definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.source_slug,
    r.dataset_name,
    r.source_record_id,
    r.observed_kind,
    r.legal_name,
    r.trade_name,
    r.activity_text,
    r.products_services,
    r.industry_codes,
    r.categories,
    r.country_code,
    r.state_code,
    r.state_name,
    r.municipality,
    r.postal_code,
    r.website,
    r.domain,
    r.business_contacts,
    r.source_url,
    r.source_span,
    r.artifact_sha256,
    r.storage_uri,
    r.provenance,
    r.source_retrieved_at,
    r.updated_at,
    r.source_fields,
    r.supplier_roles,
    r.role_classifier_version,
    r.role_classified_at,
    r.evidence
   FROM directory_rows r
     JOIN sources s ON s.slug = r.source_slug
     JOIN gtm_source_packs live ON live.slug = r.source_slug
  WHERE s.enabled AND live.licensed_for_display;
